svg.title: Dependency updates flow through the framework, not around it: On the main branch, a push pipeline leaves Renovate to the project's nightly schedule
svg.text: Dependency updates flow through the framework, not around
Scenario: On the main branch, a push pipeline leaves Renovate to the project's nightly schedule

g.text: Then a push pipeline leaves Renovate to the schedule, and only the
The terminal plays the feedback job of a push pipeline on that project's main branch. The job
finds the schedule and leaves Renovate to it, without starting Renovate.
Off camera, the same job in the scheduled pipeline runs Renovate. Once the schedule is
deleted, a push pipeline runs Renovate again, so a project without a schedule keeps getting
